questions.text: What did Haggai 1:4 reprove the people for?

options.text: That they profaned the Sabbath day while the LORD's house lay desolate
That they dwelt in cieled houses while this house of the LORD lay waste
That they served strange gods while this holy sanctuary was forsaken
That they withheld their tithes while the dwelling of God decayed

questions.text: What experience of the people is described in Haggai 1:6?

options.text: They were spoiled by enemies and lost their seed, their cattle, and money
They gathered abundant harvests and stored their riches in bags and jars
They sowed much and brought in little; wages were put into a bag with holes
They suffered great famine and their children cried for bread in distress

questions.text: Who obeyed the voice of the LORD according to Haggai 1:12?

options.text: Jehoiachin and Zedekiah the kings, with all the people from Babylon
Nehemiah and Ezra the scribe, with all the remnant of Jerusalem
Haggai and Zechariah the prophets, with all the elders of Judah
Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua with all the remnant

questions.text: What promise did the LORD give to the builders in Haggai 2:4-5?

options.text: Be strong and work, for I am with you, and my spirit remaineth among you
Ye shall have great riches, for I am with you, and the fields shall yield
Your foes shall be silent, for I am with you, and no war shall come near
Ye shall build in peace, for I am with you, and no adversary shall hinder

questions.text: What did the LORD proclaim concerning the latter house in Haggai 2:9?

options.text: The house shall be like the first, and the LORD will give peace in the land
The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former house
The house shall soon be destroyed, yet the LORD will give peace to his flock
The house shall be covered with pure gold, and the LORD will grant riches

questions.text: What did the LORD promise unto Zerubbabel in Haggai 2:23?

options.text: He will make him high priest in the temple, for he hath chosen him
He will make him king over all the heathen, for he hath chosen him
He will make him as a signet ring unto God, for he hath chosen him
He will bring him out of Babylon in peace, for he hath chosen him

questions.text: In which year of Darius the king came the word of the LORD by Haggai (Haggai 1:1)?

options.text: In the second year of Darius the king
In the fourth year of Darius the king
In the sixth year of Darius the king
In the first year of Darius the king

questions.text: What was the people commanded to bring from the mountain in Haggai 1:8?

options.text: Stones to build the strong walls of the city
Brass to make the vessels of the sanctuary
Clay to make bricks for the dwellingplaces
Wood to build the house of the living LORD

questions.text: What did the LORD call for upon the land and upon the mountains in Haggai 1:11?

options.text: A drought
The sword
A famine
A plague

questions.text: On which day did the people begin to work on the house of the LORD (Haggai 1:15)?

options.text: On the four and twentieth day of the ninth month
On the four and twentieth day of the sixth month
On the first day of the sixth month in the year
On the one and twentieth day of the seventh month

questions.text: What question did the LORD ask them that had seen the first house (Haggai 2:3)?

options.text: Who among you is ready to rebuild this house far greater than before?
Who among you destroyed this house and carried away all its treasures?
Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory of old?
Who among you remembereth the builders that first laid the sanctuary?

questions.text: Unto whom belong the silver and the gold according to Haggai 2:8?

options.text: Unto Darius the king of Persia
Unto the shaken heathen nations
Unto Zerubbabel and the priests
Unto the almighty LORD of hosts

questions.text: What do the priestly questions concerning holiness and uncleanness teach (Haggai 2:12-13)?

options.text: Holiness is not transmitted by touch, but uncleanness is
Uncleanness is not transmitted by touch, but holiness is
Both holiness and uncleanness are equally transmitted
Neither holiness nor uncleanness can ever be transmitted

questions.text: What did the LORD declare concerning the heathen kingdoms in Haggai 2:22?

options.text: He will unite the heathen kingdoms with Judah in lasting quietness
He will overthrow the throne of kingdoms and destroy their strength
He will make a covenant of peace between all the rulers of the earth
He will spare the chariots and horses of the heathen for his people
